integrity: Six source and assessment documents with a constructive program, independently implemented verifier, and explicit finite certificates, all embedded in a single private finding envelope.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the seven-leaf unrooted fully resolved class under binary one-versus-rest quartet membership. Static upper bound is a symmetry-reduced exhaustive finite proof; online lower bound is a 512-leaf certificate. No larger-order theorem or claim of exhaustive historical priority.
title: Exact binary quartet-shattering dimensions on seven phylogenetic leaves
